messages:
Maria Ramos: Quick sync — I'm updating the glossary for 'model variant' vs 'model flavor' usage. The SDK samples currently use `variant` in Python but `flavor` in JS. Which should we standardize on? Thoughts?
Kevin Li: I prefer `variant` (more concrete). If we pick `variant`, I'll send a small SDK PR to the JS snippets.
Ellie Chen: From UX POV, 'variant' maps better to the idea of deployment variants, but is a little jargon-y. Could we add a short parenthetical in the docs like "variant (model variant — e.g., fp16, q4)"?
Jamal Ortiz: Agree on `variant`. Also let's add canonical glossary id `model_variant` that we keep stable for links.
Maria Ramos: @Kevin Li @Ellie Chen ok if I add `model_variant` to the glossary and a crosslink from the SDK pages? I'll draft the phrasing.
Kevin Li: +1. I'll update the JS snippet names and leave a TODO in the Python example to rename param `flavor` -> `variant` in next PR.
Ellie Chen: Small microcopy note: avoid 'flavor' in user-facing docs. internal examples okay.
Dan (docbot): Reminder: when renaming params, add redirects for old URLs and a changelog entry. Use the template in /docs/redirects.md
Maria Ramos: Drafted wording: "model variant — a named model build/configuration (e.g., 'redwood/llama-13b-fp16')". Ping for wording review.
Kevin Li: LGTM, maybe add an example of `variant: 'llama-13b-q4'` in the code block.
Ellie Chen: Suggest adding a short 'why this term' note in the glossary to prevent future drift.
Jamal Ortiz: I'll file a tiny migration PR for existing docs that reference 'flavor' with a search/replace. Will tag you all.
Maria Ramos: Thanks — I'll create the glossary entry and link it in the SDK snippets. Targeting tomorrow EOD. :thumbsup: 
Kevin Li: Thanks!
Ellie Chen: :thumbsup: 
Dan (docbot): deploybot: docs site rebuild queued (job 8249)
Maria Ramos: Closing loop — PR numbers: #4521 (glossary), #4522 (js-snippets), #4523 (search-replace). Will update this thread when merged.
